name: 列车提夫林·男·中等
src: 主角预设（11-10）：提夫林·列车，男，中等
who: A young tiefling man from the Abyss Gallery rail corridor, a contract-town family of train crews, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 185 cm with an athletic build. Deep plum hair slicked back with a few locks escaping at the temple, heterochromatic eyes, the one on the viewer's left gold and the one on the viewer's right ice-blue (on the viewer's left/right when they face us), a handsome, composed, attentive face; two faint thin black rune-like lines under the eye on the viewer's right (on the viewer's right when they face us). Two short dark horns sweeping back from the brow and a slim black tail with an arrow-shaped tip. Pale skin. A polite, watchful air, quick to read a room.
build: About 185 cm, tall and athletic: broad shoulders tapering to a lean, trained frame, well proportioned.
palette: deep plum and charcoal, brass, cream, one small gold accent
casual: His everyday kit, in the rail corridor's contract-town style: a fitted charcoal coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and brass buttons, over a cream shirt, a narrow plum scarf, a narrow belt with a small pouch and a bronze guild token, slim dark trousers tucked into tall black boots, a brass pocket watch chain across the front. Thumb hooked in his belt, a polite half-smile.
private: At his lodging in the evening: a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark waistcoat unbuttoned, comfortable trousers, soft shoes. He holds a thin book of timetables, a finger keeping his place. A quiet, absorbed expression.
battle: An Arrayblade-style starting gear: a fitted charcoal-and-plum coat with a high collar and brass piping, light steel plates on the chest and the left shoulder, a long fingerless glove on the sword arm, slim dark trousers, tall boots. In his right hand a plain longsword held upright beside him, a few faint gold glyphs drifting near the blade. A tense, ready stance.
formal: Black Radiance formal dress: a long black tailored coat with a high collar, wine-red piping and a row of small brass buttons, a narrow wine-red sash, white gloves, dark trousers and polished boots. Hair slicked back. Upright and composed.
art: A three-quarter view, the sword held up before his face so that the blue reflection lights one eye and the gold the other, a composed, slightly guarded look at the viewer.
battle_note: The slim tail comes out through a slit in the back hem of every coat; both short horns stay bare; the two eye colours stay as written; the faint black lines under the eye on the viewer's right stay.
